sloka: दृष्ट्वा वयम् प्रव्यथिताः संभ्रांता नष्ट चेतसः ।कस्य एते कांचना वृक्षाः तरुण आदित्य सन्निभाः ॥४-५१-४॥
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vayam pravyathitāḥ saṁbhrāṁtā naṣṭa cetasaḥ ।kasya ete kāṁcanā vṛkṣāḥ taruṇa āditya sannibhāḥ ॥4-51-4॥

translations.english: 'To whom do these golden trees resembling the rising Sun belong? For whom are these tasty roots and fruits? Whose are these manystoreyed golden houses with glittering windows adorned with silver lattices encrusted with gems?
